phase: prospective candidate search before flagship selection
initial_information: Discover a consequential unmet productive need not explicitly supplied as an application. Examine broad constraints, resources and newly available agent capabilities. Exclude battery diagnostics, microscopy transfer, manufacturing checks, backup capacity, generic coordination and conventional optimization as headline contributions. Construct a bounded executable demonstration with documented prior-art comparison and same-offering economics. No live spending, wallet actions or permissions expansion.

arms.U_proxy: Single general frontier-agent search with a general opportunity prompt, tools available, and identical candidate/search budgets; no elicited expert search protocol.
arms.E_proxy: Same available parent model and tools; explicit restriction-first search, cross-domain combination, prior-art adversarial elimination, construction-first falsification and commercial participation checks.

selection_rule: Do not select on score alone. Candidate must survive documented prior-art challenge and have a falsifiable construction. If none qualifies, report exploratory negative result and refine rather than relabel.
limits: Single runs, inherited frontier model configuration, tools and execution time recorded where observable. Token equality not guaranteed. Not representative ordinary humans, not a human trial, not a claim of beyond-human foresight. No later outcome enters initial inputs. Root synthesis after the arm outputs is separately recorded.
